name: Equipoise Palm
description: Strike with a palm balanced exactly between attack and guard so it can turn to either at once.

name: Counterstance
description: Take a stance whose every lean is met by an equal lean the other way so no blow shifts it.

name: Equipoise Step
description: Pace across a line while giving up no balance so a step may be turned into a strike.

name: Tandem Breath
description: Breathe in time with an ally so that their qi runs together without one rushing the other.

name: Equipoise Seal
description: Hold two of the opponent's pulses against each other until his qi can no longer leave the body.

name: Level Rinse
description: Wash a lopsided taint from an ally by drawing the same measure from each side.

name: Equipoise Break
description: Meet an enemy technique with an exact equal and cancel it then step through and strike.

name: Rekindled Balance
description: Bring back a person whose breath has just stopped by setting heart and breath in step again.

name: Center Palm
description: Strike with a palm from the still hub of the field so the force arrives with no wasted motion.

name: Unmoved Ward
description: Hold the hub of the field fixed so that all the pulling about it adds up to nothing.

name: Center Pivot
description: Pivot around the hub of the field to change facing without any motion of the center.

name: Hub Cast
description: Cast a bead of qi from the hub that travels exactly as far as the foe stands from it.

name: Center Sense
description: Feel the whole field from its hub and learn which edge is pulled harder than the rest.

name: Center Pull
description: Draw the opponent toward the hub of the field until he is held in place by every direction at once.

name: Calming Pulse
description: Send a slow even pulse of qi through an ally's body until pain and panic settle together.

name: Spin Deflect
description: Turn about the hub so that an attack is carried round the body and lost behind it.

name: Unmoved Center
description: Stand at the hub and let every force in the field cancel on the user and press the foes down.

name: Hub Rebuke
description: Gather an incoming strike into the hub and release it from the same point back at its maker.

name: Twin Pan
description: Strike with both palms level like two pans so that the weight lands on both sides at once.

name: Scale Pair Ward
description: Hold two guards as the pans of a scale so that a blow on one is shared by the other.

name: Pan Step
description: Step with the arms held out as pans and never let one side dip lower than the other.

name: Twin Weigh
description: Weigh two nearby people in the two palms to learn which holds the greater strength.

name: Paired Counter
description: Turn aside one blow with the left pan and strike with the right in the same breath.

name: Beam Lock
description: Lay a beam of qi across the opponent's arms and hold them level against his will.

name: Beam Mend
description: Level an ally's torn side with the sound side on the beam until the hurt is shared and eased.

name: Scales Descend
description: Lower the heavier pan of the foe's stance with a crushing blow and lift the lighter.

name: Pair Accord
description: Bring the strength of the two nearest allies into accord so that each guards and is guarded.

name: Waterline Palm
description: Strike with a palm held flat like a still waterline so the blow comes level and unerring.

name: Waterline Ward
description: Hold the guard as a still surface of water that returns to level after each blow.

name: Even Current
description: Glide on a current that runs neither fast nor slow and carries the body a smooth pace.

name: Waterline Flick
description: Flick a drop of level water qi at the target's hand and weaken his grip.

name: Current Reading
description: Read which way the pulls of qi run in the near field by the drift of a thin film of water.

name: Waterline Mend
description: Draw the swelling from an ally's wound down to the level of the sound flesh about it.

name: Settling Flood
description: Spread a low flood of water qi over the ground until every foe sinks to the same level.

name: Clearwater Rinse
description: Rinse an ally in clear level water to wash out poison and the heat of fever.

name: Flow Parry
description: Turn a strike along the surface of a flowing film so that it runs off the user's side.

name: Level Flood
description: Raise a great level flood that spreads over the field and presses every foe down to its depth.

name: Equal Tide
description: Bring a slow even tide to all near allies that closes their wounds and brings their strength level.

name: Levelsworn Palm
description: Strike with a palm sworn to the level so the blow lands neither high nor low.

name: Levelsworn Ward
description: Keep a ward that the wind cannot tilt however hard it pushes from the side.

name: Levelsworn Step
description: Take a pace against the gust with the wind's pressure met by an equal lean forward.

name: Levelsworn Sense
description: Feel through the wind on the skin which side of the field presses hardest.

name: Oath Weighing
description: Weigh the sworn level against one foe and press him down until he matches it.

name: Level Binding
description: Bind a technique to the level so that it cannot rise above or fall below the user's.

name: Vow Rinse
description: Wash the taint of a broken oath from an ally and restore the evenness of his qi.

name: Windlevel Break
description: Cancel an enemy technique with a sworn level of equal weight then break through its caster.

name: Sworn Evening
description: Even out the wounds and weariness of sworn allies until each stands at his best.

name: Evenfoot Palm
description: Strike with a palm from a stance with both feet at the same depth and weight.

name: Steadfast Ward
description: Hold a ward that settles on a wide even base and does not shift under force.

name: Steadfast Stride
description: Stride out with a long even gait that gives away neither start nor stop.

name: Plumbed Cast
description: Cast a plumbed bead of qi straight down the line of sight to the foe's center.

name: Lay Reading
description: Read the lay of the open ground through the soles and learn who tilts it.

name: Oath Level
description: Speak the oath and press every opponent's qi down to the user's own level.

name: Plateau Calm
description: Lay a broad calm over an ally so that his pain is spread flat and quickly worn away.

name: Settling Parry
description: Settle the weight on one foot and turn the strike across the level of the body.

name: Leveling Wave
description: Flatten the whole field of the oath so that every foe stands at one level under its weight.

name: Sworn Counterweight
description: Hold a sworn counterweight that returns each blow to its source with equal force while the user stands unmoved.
